## Enhanced arcade-colour assets

`namco-gun-pink.tcgun` is a selective pink colour variation of the existing
Namco Arcade Gun by Martoscar (CC BY 4.0), preserving its geometry and calibration.
Original attribution, source and earlier conversion notices below/above remain.
The modified asset metadata records its source checksum and colour-only changes.

`arcade-machine-gun.tcgun` and `arcade-shotgun.tcgun` are original exterior-only
virtual game props by Thatcher Productions, generated by
`tools/build_arcade_weapons.py`. The turquoise machine gun is a stylised
interpretation of the Crisis Zone cabinet controller, not a scan or exact replica.
The orange shotgun is an original arcade-style prop, not an official Namco asset.
New mesh/generator contributions are offered under this repository's existing
source license; Namco retains its original game and trademark rights.
